ayahOccurrences.text: وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَعَنَتِ is in the derivative form: عَنَا
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ن/و ʿ–n–w to be humble, to be subservient, to yield, to show humility, to submit, to humble oneself; to take by force, force, to take as prisoner of war, to be imprisoned; to show interest; to take something; to mean, meaning; title. Of this root, only عَنَتِ‏ʿana(t) occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
عَنَا ʿanā u [v. intrans.] to become servile, to become humble, to be lowly; to become submissive, to bow

(20:111) وَعَنَتِ‏ ‏الْوُجُوهُ‏ ‏لِلْحَيِّ‏ ‏الْقَيُّومِ faces will become humble (or, downcast) before the Living, Eternal One.
